notes: The actual E105 coset origin, rational-two endpoint correction, global Shapiro inverse, class-two BCH gauge and four-coset pullback are retained. The remaining H1(V(1)), H1(V(1)chi2), H1(U_CM) factors and compact/mixed arithmetic inputs remain explicit unevaluated targets. E.108 evaluates every zero-compact quartic abelian input through55 exact shifted cups and the full restricted residue correction, without closure. It proves the rank5 two-ramified family and an explicit norm49 integral three-primary nonlifting example over the zero toric minimum. Actual Fourier and CM projections evaluate the peripheral and determinant central factors; the three displayed CM cohomology types and mixed inputs remain active. Completed full audit and exact replay scopes are in the attached root/peer records.
